basic_info.description: Experience the best of San Francisco living in this stunning unit located in the heart of the Inner Sunset. Step inside the light-filled 2 bedroom and 1.5 bathroom home to find an open floor plan that extends outdoors to your private courtyard, making it ideal for entertaining. The fully renovated kitchen showcases top-of-the-line appliances from Sub-Zero, Viking, and Bosch. With plenty of storage and sleek finishes, this culinary space is as functional as it is beautiful. Throughout the home, you’ll find thoughtful updates, including matching french patio doors with blinds between the glass and updated flooring in the main bathroom. The unit also features integrated smart home technology, including automated wood blinds and smart light switches, adding a layer of modern convenience. Additional conveniences include assigned parking with EV charger and laundry in unit. Just moments from Golden Gate Park, local shops, cafes and restaurants on 9th ave.
